fields.Field Name (Local ES): CUNE - Codigo Unico de Nomina Electronica
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. The CUNE is the SHA-384 hexadecimal digest (96 hex characters) of ELEVEN concatenated inputs, in this exact order and with no separators (Technical Annex s.8.1.1.1): [1] NumNE = Prefix + Sequence number (NIE012); [2] FecNE = FechaGen (NIE026, AAAA-MM-DD); [3] HorNE = HoraGen including the GMT offset (NIE027); [4] ValDev = DevengadosTotal (NIE187), decimal point, 2 decimals TRUNCATED, no thousand separators, no currency symbol; [5] ValDed = DeduccionesTotal (NIE188), same format; [6] ValTolNE = ComprobanteTotal (NIE189), same format; [7] NitNE = employer NIT (NIE033) without dots, hyphens or the verification digit; [8] DocEmp = employee document number (NIE045) without dots or hyphens; [9] TipoXML (NIE202); [10] Software-Pin - the secret PIN, which NEVER appears in the XML; [11] TipAmb = Ambiente (NIE023). PERSISTENCE: the CUNE is immutable once the document is validated. Any change to any of the eleven inputs produces a different CUNE and therefore a different document; corrections are made by an adjustment note carrying its own CUNE and referencing the original.

fields.Field Explanation: A CONSTANT. Must contain exactly the words 'CUNE-SHA384'. Declares the hash algorithm used for NIE024 so that a verifier can reproduce the digest.

Input [4] to the CUNE, where it must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - truncated, not rounded, a distinction that catches many implementations. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client's G2N groups WTs as 'Entitlements', 'Deductions' and 'Non Cash Earnings/Deductions'. Total = all 'Entitlements' WTs mapped to Devengados elements, plus only those informative 'Non Cash' earnings explicitly mapped (NIE193 / NIE154); employer contributions and bases in the Non Cash grouping are never included. Negative Entitlement lines occur (e.g. 62216 -3,319,075; 62540 -971,899) and no element accepts a negative: the rule (net against the same concept, or report as a deduction) must be defined before build.
fields.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Rounding element NIE186. Technical Annex s.1.1.1.
fields.Query to RA: Decide how negative entitlement lines in the client G2N (e.g. 62216, 62540 reversals) are reported, given Negative = N on every NE amount.
fields.RA Comments: Corrected

fields.Field Explanation:
Sum of every element in the Deductions block. Item 7 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [5] to the CUNE, truncated to two decimals. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): total = absolute value of all G2N 'Deductions' WTs mapped to Deducciones elements, plus only the offsetting informative deductions explicitly mapped (NIE195). The client stores deductions as negative amounts; convert the sign. Ignore 0-value rows of 2552/2553 in the Non Cash grouping.
fields.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Rounding element NIE186. Technical Annex s.1.1.1.
fields.RA Comments: Corrected

fields.Field Explanation:
DevengadosTotal minus DeduccionesTotal, adjusted for the Rounding residual. Item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [6] to the CUNE, truncated to two decimals. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): must reconcile to the cash net paid: ComprobanteTotal = Entitlements + Deductions + any non-cash item that funds a cash deduction (in Sep-2026, WT 67090 'Loan without interests Payment Inf.' offsetting WT 21215), which ties to the client's Bank Payments 'Net Pay' for 255 of 255 employees (Accumulated WT 26998 'Net salary (notional)' carries the same figure). No employee had a negative net in Sep-2026. WT 1910 'Previous periods receivables' (2 cash-paid employees, net 0 in G2N) and WT 1204 'Previous periods obligations' are carry-forward items that need the client decision listed under NIE146 / NIE197.
fields.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Rounding element NIE186. Technical Annex s.1.1.1.
fields.Query to RA: Decide the NE treatment of the carry-forward WTs 1910 'Previous periods receivables' and 1204 'Previous periods obligations' (see NIE146 / NIE197), and confirm that a non-cash item funding a cash deduction (WT 67090) is included so that ComprobanteTotal equals the bank net.
fields.RA Comments: Corrected

fields.Field Explanation: Annex table 5.5.8: 1 Replace (replace, for arithmetic, accounting or content errors) and 2 Delete (cancel a document transmitted in error). NOTE the annex's own caveat: code 2 only INVALIDATES the erroneous document - it does not by itself restore the position, so a corrected document must follow. Bidirectional set with the whole adjustment-note payload: the value chosen here decides which block is populated - 1 (Replace) requires the full replaced-document block NIAE001 to NIAE213, and 2 (Delete) requires only the cancelled-document block from NIAE236 onward.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Tipo de Nota de Ajuste (table 5.5.8)

fields.Conditional Reason: The Replace block is present when 'Adjustment note type' (NIAE214) = 1, and absent when it = 2. Mutually exclusive with the Delete block. Bidirectional pair with NIAE214.
fields.Field Explanation: Where the note replaces a document, the Replace block repeats the ENTIRE NominaIndividual structure with corrected values, under NIAE-prefixed codes that mirror the NIE codes one for one (NIAE023 = Ambiente, NIAE044 = TipoDocumento, NIAE187 = DevengadosTotal, and so on). It carries its OWN CUNE, computed on the same eleven inputs from the Replace block.

fields.Field Explanation: Synchronous SOAP response returned in the same call as SendNominaSync. THIS IS A HARD INBOUND DEPENDENCY, not a receipt: a payroll cost is tax-deductible only where the supporting document has been validated, so the engine must parse and persist the outcome.

fields.Field Explanation: The validation verdict, base64-encoded inside the SOAP response. Decode it, read the acceptance or rejection, and store the raw payload for audit - it is the employer's evidence that the document exists in DIAN's system.
fields.RA Comments: Inbound ApplicationResponse - verified against Annex v1.0 s.9 (SendNominaSync); not an XSD element.

fields.Field Explanation: Derived acceptance status. Store per document per employee per period. A rejection must trigger correction and re-transmission; an unvalidated document must block the tax deduction of the corresponding payroll cost in the client's ledger.
fields.RA Comments: Inbound ApplicationResponse - verified against Annex v1.0 s.9 (SendNominaSync); not an XSD element.

fields.Field Explanation: The validation rules breached, from Technical Annex s.6.1. The frequent ones are NIE022 (wrong Version literal), rule 90 (document number already used for that employee) and rule 92 (issuer not enabled). Persist them: they drive the correction path.
